findings.description: Settle-pass polling bounded to SettleConfig.max_polls (default 8 polls); spec SHEET-MARK-006 silent on boundary. Code enforces: poll until all requested symbols are numeric-or-terminally-errored OR max_polls exhausted; still-transient symbols degrade TimedOut (or carry prior if exists). Materially affects when marks degrade.

Price rounding rule: round_half_to_even(price_usd × 100 × 1_000_000, 1_000_000); spec silent. Non-finite prices degrade Permanent; non-positive or rounding to ≤0 Cents degrade SubCent. Conversion is single canonical site at price_to_cents() lines 362-385.

Per-symbol carry logic during settle pass (lines 873-883): Numeric reading → mark produced; Transient + prior mark exists → carry prior (no degrade); Transient + no prior → degrade TimedOut; Permanent reading → degrade Permanent, NO prior carry. Spec SHEET-MARK-006 silent on per-symbol behavior.

Mark stamping uses GOOGLEFINANCE quote_date (quote epoch from GOOGLEFINANCE.tradetime), not wall-clock read time (line 860, 318-320). Formula at quote_date_formula() (line 270-274) encodes locale-proof epoch days since 1970-01-01; spec silent on timestamp choice.

Degraded symbols omitted from to_ledger_marks() projection (lines 341-346): only good marks in ledger marks map injected into replay. Causes per-symbol degradation in ledger-core (unrealized → None, not zero). Spec SHEET-MARK-006 silent on downstream degradation handling.
